body: SEC Crypto Rules Tighten Focus on Custody and Tokenized Securities

sourceReview.reason: The Crypto Daily article combines the SEC's October 1 custody-rule proposal with its October 23 fiscal 2027 examination priorities and reports no new October 28 action. The tokenized-securities examination event is already verified and published as 'SEC Adds Tokenization to Fiscal 2027 Examination Priorities'; the custody proposal is older than the 48-hour news window.
